people.imagined: Over the marsh at dawn, on the back of her crane king. She has just let out a great laugh at something below that carries across the reeds. Wind pulls down from her braid.
people.subject: The moment: riding high on a huge grey-and-white crane's back above a misty marsh, she throws back her head in a big carrying laugh and then looks straight at the viewer, wind whipping her. Face: wiry, weathered and tanned, high cheekbones; deep laugh lines; a wide mouth open in a laugh showing strong teeth; bright narrow dark eyes; straight dark brows; a small windburn patch on each cheek. A small old scar nicks the left eyebrow, and her ears are pink with cold. Hair: long black braid with a few silver threads, thrown over one shoulder, white crane down caught in it in several tufts, clearly visible. The braid is tied at its end with a strip of blue cloth and four separate tufts of down are caught along its length. Body: lean and tough, relaxed in the saddle. Her thighs grip the crane's back and her weight shifts easily with the bird's wingbeat. Clothing: a grey felt tunic, well cut and clean, under a cloak edged with a thick border of white crane down; leather wrist guards. Hands and objects: one hand grips a rein of plaited cord; at her belt hangs a small round bronze bell, shining, in clear view. Background: blurred pale blue sky, a long sheet of silver marsh far below, the long grey neck and black-tipped wing of the crane at the frame edge. Light: bright golden morning light from the upper left. Qi: a faint green-white swirl of air around the cloak. Expression: joyful, loud, kind. Delight and wind-bright tears at the corners of her eyes.

people.imagined: On the winter terrace in a gale, he squints into the wind looking for a Wind-born child among the camp. The cloak snaps behind him. He knows he was a week too late once and will not be again.
people.subject: The moment: standing on an exposed windy terrace, he squints hard into the wind with narrowed eyes and looks at the viewer without speaking. Face: a lean, hard, wind-cut face of brown leather; deep creases from the eye corners; a long straight nose; cracked lips pressed closed; short stubble grey at the chin; dark eyes squeezed almost shut; a narrow scar on the forehead. Hair: dark brown going grey, cropped short and flattened by the wind, a leather band around the brow. The leather band across his brow is cracked and dark with sweat; grey hairs show at the temples. Body: wide-shouldered, solid, braced against the wind. Clothing: a heavy cloak of crane down quilted between two layers of grey felt, high collar of white down turned up around the jaw; beneath it a grey felt tunic of fine make; felt gloves. The cloak's quilting is in diamond rows, the down at the collar is yellowed and flattened by his breath, and a plain bone toggle fastens it. Hands and objects: both hands hold the cloak closed at the chest. His gloves are grey felt with thick leather palms, and the right glove has a long mended split. Background: blurred pale grey sky, bare brown rock and a distant tilted line of mine head-frames, streaks of wind-blown dust. Light: pale hard grey light from the upper left. Qi: faint dusty-gold motes whipping in the wind. Expression: silent, stubborn, searching. He looks at the viewer as at a stranger who may or may not have wind in the blood.

people.imagined: In the reeds at dawn, standing knee-deep, a fluffy crane chick clamped under her arm, counting the old cranes in her head. She looks up slowly.
people.subject: The moment: standing knee-deep in marsh water with a fluffy grey chick tucked under one arm, she lifts her slow gaze toward the viewer. Face: broad, round and calm; weathered pink-brown skin; wide-set soft brown eyes with deep creases; a broad flat nose; a full gentle mouth; a few grey hairs at the brow; reed-cut scratches on her cheek. Hair: black streaked with grey, in a thick low braid wound around her head and pinned with a reed stem. A few wet strands cling to her cheek. Body: slow, broad and heavy, wide shoulders, steady. Clothing: a plain marsh-green cloth tunic of fine weave, hem tied up to the knees; over it a cape woven of pale reed; the outer-gate grey sash; the lower robe wet and dark to the knee. The cape's reeds are pale gold and tied with green cord in neat rows; the hem is stained dark with water. Hands and objects: her left arm holds a fluffy, rounded, ash-grey crane chick with oversized feet against her side; her right hand, covered in fine red reed cuts, rests on its back. Background: blurred green reeds, still silver water, a distant row of tall pale birds in mist. Light: soft misty morning light from the upper left. Qi: a faint pale green-blue water glow at the ankles. Expression: patient, motherly, sad. Her slowness is not dullness; the eyes are deep and thoughtful, and she seems to be counting something very sad.

people.imagined: Landing at a vassal's gate on a windy afternoon. He has been drinking with the envoy and starts talking before his feet touch down. The jade tallies clink in his satchel.
people.subject: The moment: just landed from the air, he leans toward the viewer with a wide chatty grin, flushed and mid-sentence, one arm flung out, having drunk with the envoy and started talking before his feet touched the ground. Face: a round, cheerful, ruddy face with flushed cheeks, a broad mouth in a gap-toothed grin, bright brown eyes squeezed by smile lines, thick untidy brows and a short stubbly chin. Hair: brown and windswept, tied back loosely with a green cord that has a crane feather stuck through it. Body: sturdy and loose-limbed, rocking forward on his toes. Clothing: a grey felt riding tunic of fine make with doubled, neatly stitched seams, open at the collar, and a short cloak of white combed crane down thrown back over one shoulder; across his back a leather satchel closed with a small brass buckle, a loop of small green jade tally tokens, plain and unmarked, clearly visible on the strap. Hands and objects: one hand holds a small round wine gourd by its cord, swinging; the other arm is flung out as he talks. Background: blurred gate towers and flags in pale sun, a crane's wing at the frame edge. Light: bright warm afternoon light from the upper left. Qi: a faint warm earth-gold shimmer. Expression: a merry, slightly tipsy grin with the eyes bright and unfocused, the face of a man who has told everyone everything except what he carries.

people.imagined: Below a vast cliff, in a long wait for a roc. She narrows one eye at the ledge far above, one hand wedged in a bucket of goat. She has no doubt it will let her near.
people.subject: The moment: standing under a high cliff, she looks up at a ledge with one eye squeezed narrow, then turns the same hard look on the viewer. Face: a sharp, lean, weathered face; copper-brown skin; high cheekbones; a strong hooked nose; one eye narrowed hard and the other wide open and dark; thick straight brows; a thin mouth set in ambition. A small scar crosses her chin, and a vertical line between her brows deepens when she glares upward. Hair: black, in a tight single braid wrapped around the head, coarse goat hair stuck to it. Body: tall, hard and wiry. Clothing: a close grey felt tunic with a rider's cloak edged in down, both sleeves covered in coarse pale-brown goat hair, plainly visible; leather wrist guards. The felt tunic is neat and well fitted; the down-edged cloak is stained with dust at the hem; the leather wrist guards are laced tight. Hands and objects: one hand rests on the rim of a wooden bucket of raw meat; the other points one finger up toward the unseen cliff. Background: blurred towering rust-brown cliff face and a tiny dark nest ledge, a huge shadow passing. Over her head the cliff is streaked with white droppings, and a huge nest of sticks is a dark mass on a distant ledge. Light: hard bright light from the upper left, deep cliff shade behind. Qi: a faint grey-gold dust-and-air shimmer. Expression: ambitious, fearless, cold.

people.imagined: At dawn on the feeding platform, she has just given her crane today's new name and sulks that nobody used it. A feather braided in her hair; scars up both arms.
people.subject: The moment: at the edge of a feeding platform at dawn she thrusts out her chin and glares at the viewer in a mock sulk, then a smile breaks through. Face: a small, sharp, freckled face with a tilted nose; tanned cheeks; bright hazel eyes; short thick brows; full lips pulled into a pout. Her eyes are green-flecked hazel and her lashes pale; a smear of fish scale shines on her cheek. Hair: auburn-brown, in a single braid with one long grey-and-white crane feather woven into it, hanging in front of the shoulder. Body: small, wiry, fidgety. Clothing: a close grey felt tunic with the sleeves pushed up to the elbow; both forearms are covered in white hawk-claw scars, a dozen thin parallel lines each, bright against the tan; a short crane-down cloak. The cloak's down is tousled from flying; the leather wrist guards are decorated with small painted feathers. Hands and objects: her two hands hold a bucket of silver fish against her chest. Background: blurred wooden platform rail, pale sunrise, a tall grey bird head in the corner. Light: warm pink dawn light from the upper left. Qi: a faint warm-gold shimmer in the air. Expression: sulky, proud, quick to joy. The sulk is half a game, and the real feeling underneath is happiness she cannot contain.

people.imagined: Mid-yawn at the dawn feed, leaning on a bucket and half asleep. He has long since given up wanting to ride.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the feed trough before the sun is fully up, he yawns widely with one hand half raised, rubbing an eye, half asleep at the dawn feed and long since reconciled to never riding. Face: a round, soft-cheeked, smooth young face with fair skin, sleepy heavy-lidded brown eyes with one squeezed shut in the yawn, thick dark brows, a wide yawning mouth, chapped lips, a faint sleep crease on one cheek and a little drool at the chin. Hair: black, tousled and flat on one side from the pillow, with a cowlick standing at the crown and the nape dark with sweat. Body: soft, loose and a little round-shouldered. Clothing: a marsh-green cloth tunic of fine weave under a pale reed cape, the hem tied up in a neat knot for wading, the sleeves pushed up. Hands and objects: the right hand rubs one eye; the left lazily holds the handle of a wooden bucket of silver minnows for the chicks, water from it splashed over his bare toes; both palms are visibly smooth and soft. Background: a blurred grey wooden trough, mist over the water, and a heron standing in the shallows beyond, still as a post. Light: very dim grey-blue light before sunrise from the upper left. Qi: none. Expression: sleepy and unbothered, a faint contented smile on the stretched face, the peace of someone who has made friends with a smaller life.

people.imagined: Alone at the edge of the grooms' yard, his kit-bag clutched in his lap, someone has said a name too near. He stares back and swears he has not heard.
people.subject: The moment: seated at the edge of the grooms' yard, a battered kit-bag clamped between both arms and knees, he looks at the viewer with careful blank eyes and tight shoulders after someone said a name too near, swearing without a word that he has not heard. Face: a long, narrow, pale face with a high-bridged nose, thin lips pressed together, heavy dark brows, guarded dark eyes with shadows beneath them and a slight clench in the jaw. Hair: black, cropped short, with a tuft standing up at the crown and a few hairs shorn unevenly at the nape. Body: thin and lanky, hunched protectively over the bag. Clothing: a neat marsh-green cloth tunic of good weave with the collar turned up, a pale reed cape over it, and a coil of rope belt tied in a firm double knot. Hands and objects: both arms wrap a brown leather kit-bag against his chest; at its open top the sharp tip of an old spearhead wrapped in grey cloth shows, clearly visible. Background: a blurred dull reed wall and a dark doorway. Light: flat grey light from the upper left. Qi: a faint cold blue shimmer. Expression: a careful, blank, watchful face with the mouth set and the eyes steady, as though he practised the look in a mirror and has not allowed it to slip.

people.imagined: Her first month, holding a bucket she doesn't quite know how to carry, smelling of river pine, blisters on both hands, grinning anyway.
people.subject: The moment: standing holding a heavy wooden bucket with both hands, she looks wide-eyed at something large out of frame, then at the viewer with a wide honest grin. Face: a round, open, tanned face with a sunburnt nose; big clear hazel eyes; thick light brows; wide happy mouth; a smudge of mud on the cheek. Hair: brown, in a thick plait down her back, fine curls at the forehead. The plait is tied with a strip of pale green reed; fine curls frame her forehead. Body: sturdy, strong-shouldered, short. Clothing: a marsh-green cloth tunic, neat and new, with a pale reed cape and rope belt; the hem tied up; a wet patch on one sleeve. The cape is new and stiff, with loose ends of reed sticking out; the tunic hem has a wet patch. Hands and objects: both hands wrapped around the bucket handle, each palm showing a raw red rope blister; the bucket full of silver minnows. Background: blurred green reeds and the hint of tall pale birds. Light: bright fresh morning light from the upper left. Qi: none. Expression: honest, delighted, awed. She grins before she knows what she is grinning at, a girl for whom everything is new.

people.imagined: Beside a hurt crane's wing, fresh blood on her apron, a reed splint in her hand, saying something furious about the Pivot out loud.
people.subject: The moment: bent over an injured bird's wing, she looks up at the viewer with a fierce scowl, mouth open as if scolding. Face: a strong, square, brown face with a stubborn jaw; sharp dark eyes under thick straight brows pulled down; a broad nose; wide mouth open mid-shout; faint scar on the chin. Her cheeks are red with temper and a vein shows at her temple. Hair: black, in a low knot, a reed splint tucked behind each ear, both clearly visible. Body: strong, medium height. Clothing: a marsh-green cloth tunic with a pale reed cape thrown back; over it a long canvas apron streaked with dark crane blood; sleeves pushed up. The apron has three kinds of stain on it: old brown, fresh red, and a smear of green medicine paste; the reed cape is tied at the throat with a cord. Hands and objects: one hand holds a wing of grey and white feathers gently; the other holds a straight reed splint bound with cord. Background: blurred wooden pen, a tall bird's head, straw. Light: warm side light from the upper left. Qi: a small soft green glow at her fingertips. Expression: furious, tender. Fury and tenderness at once; her mouth is open for a scolding, and her fingers on the wing are soft.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the founder at the moment he shared first breath with a crane, a feather braided into his beard.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a lean hawk-catcher stands face to face with a great crane, forehead nearly touching its beak, eyes closed. Face: lean, hard and weathered; a long thin nose; high cheekbones; deep eye creases; closed eyes; a calm mouth; a beard of grey-brown hair with one long white-and-grey crane feather braided into its middle, clearly visible. Hair: dark brown, tied in a high knot with leather. Two small crane feathers are braided into the beard's end and a leather lace ties the knot. Body: tall and spare. Clothing: an old-style grey felt tunic and a short cloak with a ruff of white down, a hawk-catcher's leather glove on one forearm. The glove is old dark leather with a brass stud; the cloak's down ruff is thick and yellowed. Hands and objects: the gloved hand rests on the long neck of the crane. Background: a pale reed marsh in mist and one long grey bird neck, soft. Light: soft gold from the upper left. Qi: a faint pale-green breath-mist between man and bird. Expression: peaceful, devout. His closed eyes and slight smile show a quiet joy; there is no fear in him.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the rider before her last crossing. A slate-grey riding cap, her crane's neck-ring sewn to her cuff.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a young rider sits upright, steady and brave, looking straight out. She is about to fly the third crossing; her bird stands beside her, its neck-ring catching the light. Face: a youthful oval face; fair skin; steady dark eyes; straight brows; a small firm mouth; a clear brow. Hair: black, tucked up into a slate-grey felt riding cap with ear flaps, a few strands loose at the cheeks. The cap's ear flaps are tied under her chin with a thin cord. Body: slight, upright. Clothing: a slate-grey felt riding tunic, close-fitting, with a short crane-down collar; a leather wrist guard; sewn onto her left cuff, a plain small round brass ring (a crane's neck-ring), very clearly visible. Hands and objects: her left hand held up at the chest to show the cuff ring; her right hand holds a rolled letter sealed with a plain red wax blob, no writing. Background: a pale sky of washed grey and one dark bird's wing at the edge. Light: soft pale light from the upper left. Qi: a faint pale air-green shimmer. Expression: loyal, steady, brave. Her gaze is clear and untroubled, a rider who knows the odds and goes.

people.imagined: At night over the vein, a grey-bearded rider reins in his old crane. He lifts his cracked glove for silence. He does not care what the bird thinks of being flown.
people.subject: The moment: at night, riding, he turns in the saddle and raises a cracked left glove for silence, with a hard stare at the viewer, over the mountain vein with his old crane reined in. Face (most important: the cropped grey beard and the scar through the lower lip): a gaunt, hard, dark-tanned face with deep cheek lines, narrow black eyes, a flattened nose and a thin, set mouth split by one scar through the lower lip. Hair: black and grey, cropped short, with a crane quill tucked behind each ear, both visible. Body: broad, squat and rigid in the saddle. Clothing: a grey felt tunic stained with old tar at the hem and a heavy cloak edged with grey down, leather wrist guards cracked with years of riding, and on the left hand a riding glove whose leather has split across the knuckles; this is practical wear on his riding gear, not poverty. Hands and objects: the raised cracked glove with a scarred knuckle showing through the split; the other hand holds black leather reins twisted tight round the fist. Background: a black night sky, a faint blue glow of a mountain vein below and one large pale wing at the frame edge. Light: cold blue glow from below and the left. Qi: a faint cold blue earth-light. Expression: hard and impatient, the mouth flat and the stare unsparing; there is no cruelty in the face, only the impatience of a man who does not care what the bird thinks of being flown.

people.imagined: Thigh-deep in the breeding reeds, bent, grunting to a clutch of chicks that answer him. A big grown crane nearby ignores him.
people.subject: The moment: bent and wading thigh-deep in reeds, he calls with a low grunt to the chicks around him and looks sideways up at the viewer. He has been in the reeds since dawn and the chicks have come to his call, the grown birds remain aloof. Face: a lined old brown face; a long drooping nose; sunken cheeks; small watery brown eyes; sparse white eyebrows; a toothless-looking soft mouth; a few white whiskers. A fine tremor shakes his chin when he speaks; his hands are knotted and brown. Hair: thin white hair tied in a wisp at the back, a reed through it. The reed behind his ear is dry and pale, a plain habit of years. Body: bent, stooping, thin arms. Clothing: a faded but clean and well-made marsh-green tunic with a pale reed cape and soaked hem; no shoes. The tunic's collar is open and the cape's reeds are tied with soft green grass; the lower robe is wet to the thigh. Hands and objects: a few small downy grey chicks cluster around his legs; one rests in his cupped hand. Background: blurred reeds, flat water with mist, one large crane turning away. Light: soft misty light from the upper left. A thin pearly light hangs over the water and gives his skin a grey-silver sheen. Qi: a faint pale green-blue water glow. Expression: gentle, patient, content. The gentleness in his small wet eyes is like a grandfather's.

people.imagined: In the marsh again, restless at the second bell, one hand clutching her hawk-catcher's glove, looking at the sky where she'd rather be.
people.subject: The moment: standing restlessly after the second bell, her gaze flicking from the sky to the viewer and one foot tapping, the marsh walling her in while a thin cloud drifts overhead. Face: a narrow, sunburnt, lively face with a straight nose, chapped lips, a nick on the chin, quick restless brown eyes and thick straight brows. Hair: dark chestnut in a rough high ponytail with a grey crane feather with a black tip tied into it, swinging when she shifts her weight. Body: slim, restless and leaning forward on the balls of her feet. Clothing: a grey felt rider's tunic of fine make with a small scorch mark at one cuff, a short cloak of crane down tied with a hawk-catcher's knot, and a leather belt. Hands and objects: a large, thick, scuffed hawk-catcher's glove on the right hand, held up and clenched, clearly visible. Background: blurred reeds swaying behind her under a wide, bright pale sky with one thin cloud. Light: bright cool light from the upper left. Qi: a faint thin gold-grey air-swirl. Expression: restless, eager and impatient, the bright eyes already somewhere above the marsh and the mouth pressed in a small tight line, a girl who thinks the marsh is far too small.

people.imagined: Reading a letter aloud to the grooms for a pinch of tea, a satchel strap rubbed thin on his shoulder, dust of the mine in his hair.
people.subject: The moment: reading aloud from a letter held open in front of him and glancing over its top at the viewer with a greedy smile. A groom has paid a pinch of tea and he has begun to read in a loud voice, stressing the exciting parts. Face: a young, long face with a long, prominent, slightly crooked nose (the family nose); sandy-brown skin; bright greedy dark eyes; thick brows; a wide grin. His brows are heavy and his chin is small and pointed. Hair: black, spiky, a little dusty. Body: lean and tall for his age, a bit hunched. Clothing: a grey felt rider's tunic of fine make, short crane-down cloak; across the chest a leather satchel strap rubbed thin, almost white at the edge. Hands and objects: both hands hold a sheet of paper open with a few lines of plain scribble, no characters; a small tea bag in his palm. Background: blurred grooms' yard, a pale roc-feather sticking from a post. Behind him is a half circle of grooms sitting on upturned buckets, and a long grey roc feather stuck in a post. Light: warm afternoon light from the upper left. Qi: a faint dusty-gold shimmer. Expression: eager, grabby, cheerful.

people.imagined: At a reed grave, leaning on her shovel, mud in her braid, counting in her head. A secret second ledger weighs on her.
people.subject: The moment: leaning on a long-handled shovel beside a freshly dug mound in the reeds, she stares evenly at the viewer, having just filled a grave and laid a long grey wing feather on it, a second hidden tally book tucked in her belt. Face: a plain, strong, earnest face with deep tan skin, wide-set steady dark eyes, heavy straight brows, a broad nose, a stubborn full mouth and a smear of mud on one cheek. Hair: black, in a thick braid with a clump of dried mud caught in it, clearly visible. Body: stocky and strong with sturdy shoulders, standing planted. Clothing: a marsh-green cloth tunic of good weave with the sleeves rolled to the elbow and the knees dark with damp earth, and a pale reed cape thrown back over her shoulders. Hands and objects: both hands, thick with shovel calluses across each palm, grip the shovel handle; on the small mound at her feet a single long grey wing feather lies laid flat. Background: blurred tall reeds under a low grey sky. Light: cold grey light from the upper left. Qi: a faint pale green earth glow in the soil. Expression: grave and stubborn, the mouth set and the eyes unblinking, not sad but wholly serious, a labourer's grief held in a face that will not cry.

people.imagined: In the feed boat at dusk, rowing, his face turned up toward a passing crane. The wanting is on his whole face.
people.subject: The moment: seated in a narrow rowing boat, oars held, his face tilted up toward a passing crane above, mouth slightly open, then his eyes slide to the viewer. The crane's shadow has passed over the boat and he has stopped rowing; the sack of feed lies forgotten at his feet. Face: a lean, sharp young face; sun-browned skin; a long nose; wide longing dark eyes; thin brows; chapped lips; fine lines of ambition. His cheekbones are sharp and his eyes hungry; there is a net-scar on his chin. Hair: black, tied in a short topknot with a net-cord. The topknot is bound with a string of fine net cord, and a small wisp falls over his brow. Body: lean and wiry, rower's shoulders. Clothing: a marsh-green cloth tunic with a pale reed cape on his shoulders; sleeves rolled. The cape is wet and the tunic's hem is stained with fish scale; a net-cord is looped at his belt. Hands and objects: both hands grip the oars, the fingers marked with a crosshatch of thin white net scars, clearly visible. Background: blurred still water, reeds, and one tall grey-white bird passing in a pale sunset sky. Light: soft late warm light from the upper left. Qi: a faint pale-green water-glow. Expression: longing, ambitious, restless. His longing is naked: his mouth is slightly open as if to speak to the passing bird. The ambition in his face is plain: he would trade anything for the one thing the crane will not give.

people.imagined: In the marsh hall at the copying desk, holding up inky fingers as she hides a locked chest behind her. The key hangs at her neck.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a low copying desk, she holds up ink-blackened fingers and looks at the viewer guardedly, her body angled to hide a chest. She has copied the ledger up to the 790s; the locked chest holds the pages after that, and she has just heard a step in the corridor. Face: a narrow, pale, clever face; a small pointed nose; sharp black eyes; thin pencil brows; a closed thin mouth; black ink speckle on one cheek. Her fingers have ink in the creases and a line of ink runs across her chin where she rested her hand. Hair: black, in a smooth tight knot with a bamboo pin. Body: slim, neat, shoulders pulled in. Clothing: a marsh-green cloth tunic of good weave with a pale reed cape folded beside her; at her neck on a string hangs one small iron key, in clear view. Hands and objects: the right hand, black to the second knuckle, holds a fine brush; before her a long sheet with neat rows of tiny dark marks, no characters; at the edge of the frame a dark wooden chest with a metal lock. Background: blurred dim hall, a shelf of rolled scrolls. Light: warm lamp light from the upper left. Qi: a faint green shimmer on the ink. Expression: guarded, tidy, greedy. A thin tidy smile that does not touch her eyes.
